title: A penalty-interior point method combined with MADS for equality and inequality constrained optimization
summary: This work introduces MADS-PIP, an efficient framework that integrates a penalty-interior point strategy into the mesh adaptive direct search (MADS) algorithm for solving nonsmooth blackbox optimization problems with general inequality and equality constraints. Inequality constraints are partitioned into two subsets: one treated via a logarithmic barrier applied to an aggregated interior constraint violation, and the other handled through an exterior quadratic penalty.
